requestBody.query: what happens if Bell Internet modems, Wi-Fi pods or TV receivers are not returned

200.answer: If you do not return Bell rental equipment within 30 days, you will incur non-return fees. To avoid delays, do not include Bell Mobility equipment in the same package as your Bell residential equipment.

snippets.text: Rental equipment could include any of the following: Modems Wi-Fi pods TV receivers Accessories such as remote controls, cables and power supply adapters How to return Internet modems, Wi-Fi pods and Fibe and Satellite TV receivers for customers in Ontario and Quebec How to return Internet modems, Wi-Fi pods and Fibe and Satellite TV receivers for customers in Ontario and Quebec To avoid delays in processing your return, do not include Virgin Plus Internet/Mobile or Bell Mobility equipment in the same package as your Bell residential equipment. Refer to the links below for instructions on returning each type of equipment. Virgin Plus Mobile return Virgin Plus Internet modem return Bell Mobility return Important: do not return your rental equipment to a Bell store. To return your equipment as quickly as possible to Bell, simply follow the directions below: If you already have a prepaid shipping label: Attach it to the outside of the box (packing tape is recommended).
snippets.title: How do Bell equipment returns and refunds work?

snippets.text: Important Reminder: To avoid delays, do not return your Bell residential equipment (modem, TV receiver) in the same package as your Bell Mobility devices. Learn how to return Bell residential equipment. Sending the wrong type of equipment will cause delays that may incur non-return fees. When to return Bell residential equipment When to return Bell residential equipment Cancellation of one or all of your Bell services In-warranty replacements or repairs, including Satellite TV DishCare claims* Equipment upgrades* Service removal when moving Change from Bell Satellite TV to Fibe TV or vice versa *A prepaid shipping label is included in the box with your replacement equipment. If you can't find it, follow the instructions below to get a replacement label.
